methodology: Standalone diagnostics, not competitive rankings. Sequential host client validates every field after timing; this validation stretches wall windows and allows server GC. Frontend process CPU counters exclude client/backend but include metrics requests and background GC. Phase wall counters overlap; never subtract them from CPU. Header latency is not first response byte. Five paused/aborted clients per renderer, one in flight; recovery memory is not forced-GC retained heap or proof of no leak.
